name: 1Password desktop integration (experimental)
description: Official apt CLI and single-socket integration for trusted native-Linux devcontainers. Requires Python 3 (installed).

hostCliGid.description: Required numeric group from host stat -c %g /usr/bin/op

acceptRuntimeOverride.description: Required opt-in: globally sets XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/1password-desktop; do not enable with another desktop runtime integration.
